Aisha (CS): FYI Silversail canary showed a ~12% tail spike during high RPS. p95 ~220ms, some tails ~980ms.
Ravi (SE): Any recent model/config swaps?
Aisha (CS): They flipped to compact-int8 yesterday for cost testing; tokens per req +30%. No obvious errors.
Lucas (ML): int8 + longer sequences can thrash KV cache; maybe eviction or quant artifact on KV keys.
Ravi (SE): Triage plan: 1) enable prefix KV caching, 2) loosen strict batching (max_batch_ms +=10ms), 3) 5% fp16 canary if tails persist.
Aisha (CS): Can we send a short config snippet they can paste?
Ravi (SE): Snippet:
model: redwood/compact-int8-v3
routing:
  prefer_warm_nodes: true
  fallback: redwood/fp16-latency-opt
batching:
  max_batch_ms: 20
  max_tokens_in_batch: 2048
cache:
  prefix_kv_enabled: true
  max_prefix_entries: 5000
Lucas (ML): Also run small eval set for quant artifacts and capture sample outputs.
Aisha (CS): Draft message to customer: "Can you canary 5% -> fp16 for 15m and enable prefix_kv? We'll monitor p95 and tail behavior and follow up."
Ravi (SE): I'll schedule the canary at 11:40 PT and push routing override.
deploy-bot: Deploy started by @Ravi (SE) for silversail-prod routing override (job 8921).
Aisha (CS): If p95 improves >30% recommend routing fp16 for long-tail paths, keep int8 for short requests. I'll log in onboarding tracker and post results. :thumbsup:
